title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: using the standalone MCP Server provided as part of the AL Development Tools.
summary: The AL Development Tools package now includes a standalone MCP server that allows AI coding agents to invoke AL-specific development tasks like building, debugging, and symbol searching without a GUI. The launchmcpserver command starts an HTTP-based server (default port 5000) that exposes tools for automating AL development workflows in CI/CD pipelines and AI-assisted development.
key_points: AL Development Tools is a cross-platform NuGet-based package for compiling and packaging Business Central extensions outside Visual Studio Code
The launchmcpserver command launches an HTTP-based MCP server that AI agents can use to invoke AL development tools
Available tools include building, debugging, downloading symbols, publishing, setting breakpoints, snapshot debugging, and symbol searching
The server supports configurable options like port, transport mode, telemetry, ruleset, and output folder
These tools are experimental and designed to streamline AL development workflows with AI assistance

quotes.text: This command starts up an HTTP-based MCP server, which can be used by coding agents to invoke AL-specific development tools.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes how the MCP server enables AI agents to interact with AL development workflows

quotes.text: These tools are experimental and subject to change in future updates.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets expectations about the stability and future evolution of these features
